message: ArnLike with wildcard account field on iam:PermissionsBoundary condition — matches any account's boundary policy with matching name prefix, enabling bypass via customer-managed policy with matching name

iam:ListRoles is a permission-only action (SAR: empty resource_types). The resource scope on the AllowRoleManagement statement is silently ignored — the created role can list ALL roles in the account, not just partner-managed ones.

iam:AttachRolePolicy has no iam:PolicyARN condition restricting which policies can be attached. The only guard is iam:PermissionsBoundary, which is already flagged as bypassable — adding iam:PolicyARN provides defense-in-depth.

DenyBoundaryModification only explicitly denies 4 actions. High-risk IAM write actions (iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy, iam:DetachRolePolicy, iam:DeleteRolePolicy, iam:CreateRole) are only implicitly blocked by absence from Allow statements — explicit Deny provides defense-in-depth against future boundary revisions.
